g.text: One internal split at edge 0, the most expensive level of a free-map insert (DR-103)
insert at edge 0: splitpoint picks the middle
and the new entry goes to the left half at index 0
it goes up to the parent level,
which writes it as its new slot
: 6 slots, and sets its length: 1 length
split_leaf_data sets its length to 4: 1 length
and writes the new slot: 5 slots
and writes the new edge: 5 edges
corrects the parent links of edges 1 to 5: 5 links
every other level costs at most
the last level leaves room for the map's length and root writes
: 16 operations, 7,752 scanned bytes and 3,472 backing bytes
every insert: a walk of the whole map, then
as scanned and as backing bytes
